name: Sinaloa

standard.note: Sinaloa's plate is white with 'SINALOA' and 'MÉXICO' in red along the bottom, the state coat of arms between the two words, and a QR code in the top corner.

plates.title: Current design
plates.fact: Sinaloa's plate is white with 'SINALOA' and 'MÉXICO' in red along the bottom, the state coat of arms between the two words, and a QR code in the top corner.

notes: The only official plate image I found is https://compranet.sinaloa.gob.mx/uploads/files/eL-lo2VrC6C7ETm0.jpg (3004x1496), but it is a public-transport BUS plate (A-27499-U, 'Transporte público - Autobús'), so it is excluded. The private-car note assumes the same layout (it matches UnoTV's description). The state bought new plates in 2026 (tender GES 03/2026), but I found no announcement of a new design or replating. The year the current design started and any specialty plates are unknown. Hybrid and electric cars get registration-fee discounts, but no separate plate design was found.
